hook_text: One candle, one small hole, and the most famous discovery in archaeology.
clip_script: Pretoria. An old newspaper from 1922. In the Valley of the Kings, Howard Carter had searched for years for the tomb of a young, forgotten pharaoh: Tutankhamun. On 4 November 1922, his workers found a step, then sixteen steps down to a sealed door. Carter held up a candle to a small hole. Can you see anything? Yes, wonderful things. Gold everywhere, and a king's tomb, almost untouched for more than three thousand years.
visual_style: Whiteboard newspaper headline, a staircase going down into rock, a candle at a hole in a wall, then gold glinting in the dark.
mood: Suspenseful and thrilling, like a treasure hunt.
pacing: Slow, tense build-up to the candlelit reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write the newspaper headline you would have written in 1922.
